voices.original_text: You turn on a VPN, and your internet traffic takes a new exit. What can everyone along the way still see?
voices.spoken_text: You turn on a VPN, and your internet traffic takes a new exit. What can everyone along the way still see?

voices.original_text: First, your device opens an encrypted tunnel to a VPN server. We'll follow one website request through it.
voices.spoken_text: First, your device opens an encrypted tunnel to a VPN server. We'll follow one website request through it.

voices.original_text: The tunnel is ready. Route rules choose what enters it. Here, all internet traffic uses the tunnel—a consumer full-tunnel setup. Other settings vary.
voices.spoken_text: The tunnel is ready. Route rules choose what enters it. Here, all internet traffic uses the tunnel—a consumer full-tunnel setup. Other settings vary.

voices.original_text: Your website request stays inside an outer packet addressed to the VPN server. That outer packet travels across the local network.
voices.spoken_text: Your website request stays inside an outer packet addressed to the VPN server. That outer packet travels across the local network.

voices.original_text: Your Wi-Fi and ISP can see that outer connection: the VPN server, when data moves, and roughly how much. If the tunnel works as intended, they can't read the protected traffic inside.
voices.spoken_text: Your Wi-Fi and ISP can see that outer connection: the VPN server, when data moves, and roughly how much. If the tunnel works as intended, they can't read the protected traffic inside.

voices.original_text: At the VPN server, that outer packet opens. The server forwards your original request to the website.
voices.spoken_text: At the VPN server, that outer packet opens. The server forwards your original request to the website.

voices.original_text: From the website's side, this request comes from the VPN server's public IP. That's the new exit for traffic using this route.
voices.spoken_text: From the website's side, this request comes from the VPN server's public I P. That's the new exit for traffic using this route.

voices.original_text: Your local network sees less of the protected traffic. But now your VPN provider runs that exit point. Trust has shifted.
voices.spoken_text: Your local network sees less of the protected traffic. But now your VPN provider runs that exit point. Trust has shifted.

voices.original_text: What the provider can observe or keep depends on its service and setup. A VPN doesn't replace HTTPS. HTTPS is a separate lock that can protect page contents from your device to the website, even after the VPN tunnel ends.
voices.spoken_text: What the provider can observe or keep depends on its service and setup. A VPN doesn't replace H T T P S. H T T P S is a separate lock that can protect page contents from your device to the website, even after the VPN tunnel ends.

voices.original_text: A different exit doesn't hide who you are. Sign in or bring the same cookie, and the website may recognize you.
voices.spoken_text: A different exit doesn't hide who you are. Sign in or bring the same cookie, and the website may recognize you.

voices.original_text: If a compromised device exposes information before traffic enters the tunnel, the VPN can't hide it. Protection starts at the device.
voices.spoken_text: If a compromised device exposes information before traffic enters the tunnel, the VPN can't hide it. Protection starts at the device.

voices.original_text: The tunnel may not carry every app. Split tunneling sends chosen connections out over a different route.
voices.spoken_text: The tunnel may not carry every app. Split tunneling sends chosen connections out over a different route.

voices.original_text: Even a website lookup needs a route. DNS may go through the VPN, or somewhere else; the settings decide.
voices.spoken_text: Even a website lookup needs a route. D N S may go through the VPN, or somewhere else; the settings decide.

voices.original_text: So who sees the road? Your local network sees the VPN connection. The website sees the VPN server's address. The provider sits at the exit. New path, new trust.
voices.spoken_text: So who sees the road? Your local network sees the VPN connection. The website sees the VPN server's address. The provider sits at the exit. New path, new trust.
